free_resources.title: Pujas and Puja Texts
free_resources.description: The centre's page on puja as devotional practice: offering flowers, light and incense, generating merit and practising the ritual as a meditation. It lists the pujas held regularly, including the Medicine Buddha and Pure Land pujas, and offers free PDF texts such as the Medicine Buddha puja and the Heart Sutra.

left_out: Medicine Buddha Puja video: videos are handled separately.
A weekly Medicine Buddha puja as a dated or scheduled offering: the page says only that it is held regularly, with no schedule, so it goes in as part of the free puja-texts page.
flags: Devotional ritual; the page mentions pujas for long life and wealth in passing, but makes no claim to cure or treat anything.
